concerns.text: The specification requires a train/validation/test split for threshold selection (FR-019), but no task in the list implements this split or references it. Without this split the threshold may be tuned on the test data, violating the requirement.

A simulation study to verify the signal‑to‑noise ratio of the \dot{α} estimator (FR-020) is mandated, yet no task addresses this study. The pipeline proceeds to full analysis without the required SNR validation.

The spec mandates a sample‑size check and, if anomalies < 10, execution of bootstrap resampling for inference (FR‑011, FR‑012). The tasks only set a flag in reports (e.g., T008) and never run the bootstrap procedure, leaving the requirement unfulfilled.

Constitution principle VII requires a prior‑sensitivity analysis on the Dirichlet‑process concentration hyperparameter. No task varies the concentration prior or records its impact, violating the constitutional mandate.

FR‑017 calls for a systematic search for real‑world datasets with known regime shifts and a ‘Validation Deferred’ report if none are found. Task T003 merely downloads pre‑identified datasets and does not perform the required search or deferred‑report logic.

While T009 performs threshold sensitivity, the spec also requires that thresholds be selected on a validation set (FR‑019) and that the sensitivity analysis be tied to that split. The current tasks lack any validation‑set based threshold calibration, weakening the requirement.
